categories.main_business_segments: Piotech Inc. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of high-end semiconductor specialized equipment. Its main product lines include plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) equipment, atomic layer deposition (ALD) equipment, sub-atmospheric chemical vapor deposition (SACVD) equipment, high-density plasma chemical vapor deposition (HDPCVD) equipment, flowable CVD equipment, and advanced bonding equipment and metrology devices for 3D integration applications. These products are widely applied in integrated circuit logic chips, memory chip manufacturing, and 3D integration fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed internationally advanced core technologies in thin film deposition equipment design, reaction chamber architecture, high-capacity semiconductor manufacturing platforms, plasma stability control, and precise gas transport and temperature control systems. It specializes in various CVD technologies including PECVD, ALD (both plasma-enhanced and thermal), SACVD, HDPCVD, and Flowable CVD. For 3D integration, it has proprietary high-precision wafer-to-wafer and chip-to-wafer bonding technologies, including hybrid and fusion bonding, supported by advanced metrology equipment. The company emphasizes modular design, rapid RF plasma control, and optimized reaction chamber components to ensure film uniformity, low particle contamination, and high throughput.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Piotech serves semiconductor wafer fabs primarily in China, focusing on integrated circuit logic and memory chip manufacturers. Its customers include major domestic semiconductor manufacturers and foundries expanding their production capacity. The company also targets emerging markets in 3D integration technologies, serving clients developing advanced logic chips, 3D NAND, DRAM, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and image sensors. The customer base is expanding with repeat orders and new clients entering the top five customers list in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Beijing, Zhejiang, and overseas subsidiaries in the USA, Japan, and the British Virgin Islands. Its sales and operations are predominantly focused on the Chinese mainland semiconductor market, which is the largest global semiconductor equipment market. The company is also expanding its overseas presence through subsidiaries and international investments.
categories.supply_chain_position: Piotech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying high-end semiconductor fabrication equipment. It sources key components globally but has established a diversified and stable supplier network to mitigate supply chain risks. The company also invests in upstream semiconductor equipment component suppliers through equity investments to strengthen its supply chain security and innovation capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in thin film deposition and 3D integration bonding technologies, maintaining high R&D intensity with 18.42% of revenue invested in R&D in 2024. It focuses on expanding product lines, improving equipment performance, and developing new platforms and reaction chambers. Strategic R&D projects include PECVD series, ALD series, trench filling thin film processes, 3D integration equipment, and key semiconductor equipment components. The company also invests in talent development and international collaboration to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Piotech generates revenue primarily through direct sales of semiconductor equipment, including thin film deposition machines and advanced bonding systems. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts and technical services related to the equipment. The company operates a direct sales model, engaging in contract negotiations, bidding, and providing customized equipment solutions and after-sales support to semiconductor manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor equipment market, especially in thin film deposition and 3D integration bonding, is dominated by international giants such as Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron, EV Group, BESI, and ASMPT. Piotech positions itself as a leading domestic high-end semiconductor equipment manufacturer in China, with products achieving international advanced levels and gaining increasing market share. It faces competition from both global incumbents and emerging domestic players but leverages its technology, customer proximity, and localized service advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Piotech has demonstrated rapid growth with 2024 revenue reaching approximately RMB 4.1 billion, a 51.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 688 million, up 3.86%. The company’s total assets grew 53.61% to RMB 15.3 billion, and net assets increased 14.94% to RMB 5.28 billion. It has a strong order backlog of about RMB 9.4 billion, supporting sustained growth. The company’s compound annual growth rate since 2018 is 96.79%, reflecting accelerated expansion and market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Piotech emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, rapid product iteration, and comprehensive thin film process coverage supporting over 100 process applications for logic and memory chips. Its equipment offers high stability, high throughput, and cost efficiency, including innovations like PECVD Bianca for wafer backside film deposition and advanced bonding systems with nanometer-level precision. The company provides customized solutions with strong after-sales service, close customer collaboration, and a robust supply chain, enabling domestic semiconductor manufacturers to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and improve production capabilities.
